summary: I presented the NTP precondition checklist at the Kick-off Meeting, recorded QSE's verbal responses and issued Rev B of the checklist with the Project Director's signatory confirmation and the permit and land allocation positions. I then emailed Omar Hassan to chase QSE's approval of form and the issuing bank confirmation for the APG and Performance Security by 7 December. Every verbal response stays open until QSE confirms it in writing.

documents.title: NTP Precondition Checklist - update after KOM

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and status
paragraphs: This is Revision B of the NTP Precondition Checklist HEL001-G000-K-&REG-00001, updated after the Kick-off Meeting (M02) held on 3 December 2026 (Day 2). It supersedes Revision A of Day 1. It records the status of each item that must be satisfied before the Notice to Proceed on 15 December 2026 (M01), based on the Contract and on what QSE said at the meeting.

The checklist will be updated daily until NTP. Verbal statements made at the KOM are marked as such. HEP will treat them as confirmed only when QSE gives them in writing, in line with the notice provisions of the Contract.

sections.heading: 2. Summary of position at 3 December 2026
bullets: 12 items tracked: 2 closed or held, 1 confirmed, 1 in progress, 1 not due and 7 open.
Critical path to NTP: APG and Performance Security form approval and issuing bank confirmation (comments due 7 December), then issue of the instruments.
Land allocation documents have not yet been seen by HEP and are the main external dependency for site access at NTP.
No item is yet late against the contractual date, but the margin between 7 December and 15 December is thin.

rows: Executed EPC Contract set (Agreement, Particular Conditions, Employer's Requirements, Schedules)

Submitted with item 3. Approval of form is a precondition to issue.
Issuing bank confirmation for APG and Performance Security
QSE to confirm acceptability of the proposed issuing bank in writing together with the form comments.

Evidence being compiled with the broker; transmission to QSE ahead of the 12 December due date.

Verbal indication given at KOM; written confirmation requested.
Not an NTP precondition. Application package depends on Basic Design (M04, 2027-03-15). No date has been given by the authority; position to be confirmed by Elena Petrova.

Subject to item 10; site works Mon-Sat.

sections.heading: 4. KOM outcomes recorded
paragraphs: The checklist was presented item by item. QSE's Client Project Manager, Khalid Al-Mansoori, and its Commercial & Contracts Manager, Omar Hassan, acknowledged the list. QSE's responses were verbal only. The following are recorded for follow-up (ACTIONS-001-011):
bullets: QSE to give its comments on the form of the APG and Performance Security by 7 December (ACTIONS-001-010).
QSE to confirm the issuing bank in writing at the same time.
QSE to provide the land allocation confirmation and cadastral documents.
QSE to confirm in writing its authorised signatories and the Employer's Representative.
HEP to send the insurance evidence ahead of QSE's due date of 12 December.

sections.heading: 5. Permit and land allocation positions
paragraphs: Construction permit: the permit (M07) is targeted for 20 March 2027 and is not a precondition to NTP. HEP's application depends on the approved Basic Design (M04, 15 March 2027). The competent authority, Navoi Regional Administration / State Construction Inspectorate, has not given HEP a review period. HEP will not assume one until it does.

Land allocation: HEP needs written confirmation that the land has been allocated to QSE and is free for HEP's use from NTP. Until then, HEP reserves its rights regarding the Time for Completion if site access is not given on the date of NTP.

sections.heading: 6. Signatory confirmation
paragraphs: The Project Director, Rajan Iyer, is confirmed as HEP's authorised signatory for Contract notices, and Thomas Becker as the addressee for contractual correspondence. A signature specimen sheet will be sent to QSE with the next letter. HEP asks QSE to confirm its equivalent persons.

sections.heading: 7. Next steps
bullets: Chase QSE on 7 December for the APG and Performance Security form and bank confirmation.
Issue insurance evidence to QSE by 11 December.
Update this checklist on 4 December (Rev C) and daily thereafter.
Prepare the NTP notice package for the Project Director's review once items 3 to 5 and 10 are closed.

emails.subject: APG and Performance Security - follow-up on form approval and issuing bank after KOM
emails.body:
Dear Omar,

Thank you for your time at today's Kick-off Meeting. As we noted when going through the NTP precondition checklist, HEP's letter HEL001-L-CM-HEP-QSE-0001 of 2 December submitted the forms of the Advance Payment Guarantee and the Performance Security for QSE's approval.

I would be grateful if QSE would send its comments, or its approval of form, by Monday 7 December 2026 (ACTIONS-001-010). Please also confirm in writing whether the proposed issuing bank is acceptable to QSE. We cannot ask the bank to issue the instruments until we have both.

The APG relates to the 10% advance (USD 9,500,000) and the advance payment is due on 5 January 2027 (M03). We would like to hand over the instruments before NTP on 15 December. A response on 7 December leaves about one week to finalise and issue them.

I have updated the NTP checklist to Rev B. I will send you the copy through document control. Please also confirm your authorised signatories in writing. I will send you HEP's insurance evidence ahead of your request REQ-001-client-c, which is due 12 December.

Kind regards,
Thomas Becker
Contracts & Commercial Manager, Helios EPC LLC
